captions.linkedin:
A simple test before you send a resume: could you talk for two minutes about every line on it?

Interviewers prepare by reading your resume, and every bullet is a potential question. Real work gives you easy, specific answers. Padded lines, often added by tools trying to match keywords, give you the awkward ones.

QuickFit CV tailors resumes using only what's in your profile, so every line is one you can explain.
